---
title: "GWSC Drought ERA5 Monitor"
output: html_document
---

```{r parameters}
# ============================================================
# USER PARAMETERS — edit this block only
# ============================================================

APP_COUNTRY   <- "Greece"              # Country name matching ERA5 catalog `country` column
APP_INDEX     <- "SPI"              # "SPI" | "SPEI-T" | "SPEI-P"
APP_SCALE     <- 6                  # Accumulation period: 3 | 6 | 12
APP_THRESHOLD <- -0.5               # Onset threshold: -0.5 | -1.0 | -1.5

REF_START  <- 1973                  # Reference period start year
REF_END    <- 2002                  # Reference period end year
OBS_START  <- 2003                  # Observation period start year
OBS_END    <- 2023                  # Observation period end year

OUTPUT_DIR <- "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/app_outputs"
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Internal — do not edit
.prefix <- switch(APP_INDEX,
  "SPI"    = "S",
  "SPEI-T" = "ET",
  "SPEI-P" = "EP",
  stop(sprintf("Unknown APP_INDEX '%s'. Must be SPI, SPEI-T, or SPEI-P.", APP_INDEX))
)

APP_CONFIG_ID <- sprintf("%s%d-T-%03d",
                         .prefix,
                         APP_SCALE,
                         round(abs(APP_THRESHOLD) * 100))

.index_col <- switch(APP_INDEX,
  "SPI"    = paste0("spi",  APP_SCALE),
  "SPEI-T" = paste0("spei", APP_SCALE),
  "SPEI-P" = paste0("spei", APP_SCALE, "_pm")
)

cat(sprintf("Config: %s | Country: %s | Ref: %d-%d | Obs: %d-%d\n",
            APP_CONFIG_ID, APP_COUNTRY, REF_START, REF_END, OBS_START, OBS_END))
```

```{r boundary}
script_dir <- "/Workspace/Users/tajayalath@ua.edu/Drought-indices/files/Codes/app_monitor"
# Boundary now read in-cluster from the esri table inside 01_APP_Index_Calculation.R
# (v2-consistent) — no shapefile download/upload, so 00_APP_Download_Boundary.R is
# bypassed. Kept on disk for the legacy shapefile-on-Volume integration path.
```

```{r index-calculation}
source(file.path(script_dir, "01_APP_Index_Calculation.R"))
.idx_rows <- nrow(index_monthly)
.idx_pixels <- length(unique(paste(index_monthly$x, index_monthly$y)))
cat(sprintf("index_monthly rows: %d | pixels: %d\n", .idx_rows, .idx_pixels))
writeLines(
  sprintf("index_monthly rows: %d | pixels: %d", .idx_rows, .idx_pixels),
  "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/app_outputs/app_diag_log.txt"
)
```

```{r detection}
source(file.path(script_dir, "02_APP_Detection.R"))
.ref_rows <- nrow(events_ref)
.obs_rows <- nrow(events_obs)
cat(sprintf("events_ref rows: %d | events_obs rows: %d\n", .ref_rows, .obs_rows))
write(
  sprintf("events_ref rows: %d | events_obs rows: %d", .ref_rows, .obs_rows),
  "/Volumes/projects/gwsc_drought/drought_outputs/app_outputs/app_diag_log.txt",
  append = TRUE
)
```

```{r output}
source(file.path(script_dir, "03_APP_Output.R"))
```
